        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.EnergirMailScriptsUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>EnergirMailScriptsUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var EnergirMailScriptsUtils = Class.create();
EnergirMailScriptsUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	getJournalEntries: function(tableName, recordId, element, numberOfEntries) {
		/*
			This method is an alternative to the OOB GlideElement.getJournalEntry() and differs only
			by the return format. In this method, only the text of journal entries is returned, as opposed
			to a string composed of the person commenting, the date and the entry type, in addition to the text.

			String tableName    : name of the table for which we wish to extract journal entries
			String recordId     : the sys_id of the record
			String element      : the type of journal entry we wish to extract. Can be one of:
								  - comments
								  - work_notes
								  - approval_history
								  - notes
			Int numberOfEntries : the number of entries to extract. Entries are ordered by date in descending order
								  A value of 1 would give the lastest entry, etc.
								  Use 0 or -1 to extract all entries on a given record.

			String entries[]	: Text of the extracted journal entries, with most recent entry at index 0
		*/
		
		var entries = [];
		var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_journal_field');
		gr.addQuery('name', tableName);  // Table name
		gr.addQuery('element', element);  // Type of journal entry
		gr.addQuery('element_id', recordId); // Current record
		gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
		if (numberOfEntries > 0) {
			gr.setLimit(numberOfEntries);
		}
		gr.query();
		while (gr.next()) {
			entries.push(gr.value);
		}
		return entries;
	},

	verifyMissingAttachments: function(recordId, targetTable) {
		/*
			Looks in the sys_email_attachment table for attachments belonging to targetTable.recordID
			that do not have a matching record in sys_attachment. When that happens, we have an attchment
			that was dropped by ServiceNow (for example, when the size limit set by property 
			glide.email.inbound.max_total_attachment_size_bytes is exceeded). The method can be used in 
			Notification emails scripts, for example, to notify a user that not all their attachments were
			properly received.

			String recordId    : sys_id of the record upon which we are looking for missing attachments
			String targetTable : name of the table upon which we are looking for missing attachments

			String results[]   : file names of attachments that are missing / dropped
		*/
		
		var missing = []; // Missing attachments list
		var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_email_attachment');
		gr.addQuery('email.instance', recordId);
		gr.addQuery('email.target_table', targetTable);
		gr.query();
		
		while (gr.next()) {
			if (gr.attachment == '' || gr.attachment == null) { // We detected a skipped attachment
				missing.push(gr.file_name.toString()); // Store its name
			}
		}
		return missing;
	},

    type: 'EnergirMailScriptsUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-10-11 12:35:48</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_id>df826c3f47019e1097744049116d436f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>EnergirMailScriptsUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_df826c3f47019e1097744049116d436f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2024-10-11 13:15:58</sys_updated_on><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/></sys_script_include></record_update></payload>
